description: Utility helper functions for document enrichment, including projectId normalization and updatedAt computation, used in a backend service.

methods.name: normalizeProjectId
methods.description: Normalizes various projectId field formats to a lowercase string id.

methods.name: toValidDate
methods.description: Parses a value into a valid Date object if possible.

methods.name: computeUpdatedAt
methods.description: Computes the most relevant updatedAt date from document fields or _id timestamp.

methods.name: enrichDeployment
methods.description: Returns an object with normalized projectId and updatedAt for deployment-like documents.
